# data.docker_container_changes

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the filesystem changes of a container against its image, like `docker container diff`. Each entry of `changes` has a `path` and a `kind`: 0 modified, 1 added, 2 deleted.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `changes` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | The GET /containers/{id}/changes response as a nested object, field by field. |
| `changes_json` | `string` | computed |  |  | The Engine API GET /containers/{id}/changes response as JSON; entries sorted by Path. Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact). |
| `container` | `string` | required |  |  | The container to read, by ID or name. |
| `container_id` | `string` | computed |  |  | ID of the container the changes were read from. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of changes_json. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version from GET /version. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion). |

### `changes`

nested attribute, list(object). The GET /containers/{id}/changes response as a nested object, field by field.

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_container_changes" "web" {
  container = "web"
}

# Paths the container added (kind 1) on top of its image.
output "added_paths" {
  value = [for c in data.docker_container_changes.web.changes : c.path if c.kind == 1]
}
```
